No imports, functions, classes or other assignments change; retained nonmeter reader request/result/cleanup semantics are unchanged. Profiler read request/result/normalizer, capture cursor, host requirements and Source copy/Save/graph verification paths are unchanged; global24KiB and ordinary non-log output paths remain unchanged. No original native map, fact, failure or archive is rewritten; complete current public replay remains required by existing consumers.
